description: Closed, frozen enumeration of the plugin's commands/*.md surface. This list is a ceiling, not a cull: it may shrink by attrition but must never grow. Every new workflow ships as a skill only, never as a new command. tests/orchestration/frozen-command-surface.test.mjs enforces that the on-disk commands/*.md set equals this declared set exactly. Five entries are workflow aliases that have a matching planr-* skill counterpart (hasSkillAlias: true); the remaining three are Claude-Code-only commands with no skill counterpart (hasSkillAlias: false).
